description: Matches several lines together in one call — one payment against several invoices, one invoice against several instalments — when their open debits and credits are equal to the cent: posted lines of one company, one reconcilable account, one counterparty (a line naming nobody is attributed by the matching), in the company's currency. Paired oldest first through reconcile, under one letter. Refused by name, and never settled in part: reconcile_unbalanced gives the difference. Show the user the lines and ask before calling it.

line_ids.description: The ledger lines to match together, as suggest_item_combinations returns them: the line and the lines it settles. One counterparty, one account, at least one debit and one credit.

name: reconcile_many
title: Match several ledger lines together
